prompt:
Locked-off camera. A round pub table with pints and an answer sheet. Centre, the blonde woman in the turquoise fleece with a pink collar sits facing the camera, one hand raised mid-gesture. Left, the older man in the tweed jacket and green tie sits turned toward her. Behind right, the man in glasses and the navy gilet; front right, the grey-haired man in the olive waterproof, arms folded on his knees. All three turn their eyes and heads fully onto her and hold the look. She says "I plead the Fifth." at a brisk natural pace with a sheepish little smile, both hands coming up a touch, palms out, then stops and holds the smile, waiting. Only her mouth moves for words; the three men stay silent, mouths closed, staring at her, a slow blink, the tweed man's brow lowering slightly. Same room, same warm amber light, only these four people and the drinker in the background, the picture clean. Small, real pub performance; photographic.
Thanks.
